May 3, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
Hartwell J M Limited Partnership decreased its stake in Unilever N.V. (UN) by 49.4% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hartwell J M Limited Partnership sold 8,200 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.54% with the market. The hedge fund held 8,400 shares of the package goods and cosmetics company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $473,000, down from 16,600 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hartwell J M Limited Partnership who had been investing in Unilever N.V. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $153.93B market cap company. The stock increased 0.81% or $0.44 during the last trading session, reaching $54.73. About 696,359 shares traded. Unilever N.V. (NYSE:UN) has risen 6.36% since May 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 5.19% the S&P500.
